_doc: Golden for contract-f2 (mission saoc-inner-heroes, F2: HM-5, HM-7, HM-8, /members note, HM-6 and /events/[slug] candidate sheets). Source: NOS Design 2026-10-26 '#116 (9b8a1e63) beta pass' (comms.md). Extends goldens/crop-map.json (f1); the f2 gates read both through checks/f2-lib.mjs.

hm5.ruling: HM-5: keep the same end, ease the ramp: 0 @34%, .06 @38%, .16 @42%, .32 @45%, .52 @48%, .70 @50.5%, .80 @52%. Sage rgb(34 40 31) only. Below 768 the scrim stays display:none.

focalAlpha.zone: left 0-39% of the hero: where the ruled stops stay at or under .1 (.085 at 39%). NOS Design named the focal centre 'lip/column' without coordinates; 39% is this contract's reading and is an open question (spec-f2.md).

hm8.ruling: The typographic band sizes to its content at >= 1024: padding-block clamp(64px, 6vw, 96px), no min-height. Gate: band height <= content + 192 at 1440 and 2056. < 768 unchanged. LG-RF stays green.

eventFacts.ruling: HM-7: the facts values are centred in their cells under a left-aligned h1. Left-align them to the h1's edge (one axis). The hero keeps its current photograph for now.

membersNote.ruling: P3: the 'Not yet available' note gets the legal draft-notice treatment: plain p, bold lead-in, 1px rule below, border 0, transparent. Text verbatim.

membersNote.text: Not yet available. Member login and the Members Portal itself have not been built for this site yet. This page will be updated once they are.

sheets.note: HM-6 and the /events/[slug] cut are NOT implemented in f2. The deliverable is candidate sheets for NOS Design's pick. Each candidate has an in-situ sheet (scrim, h1, chip) at 1440@2 and a 1:1 crop of the left 44% at 1440@2 showing petal veining.

candidates.ruling: HM-6 (a): the violet top-right bloom, flipped so it sits in the left 44%; window >= 4082 wide; not /about's centre bloom or /contact's hanging bloom.
HM-7: one cut distinct from home's dark and /sponsors' dark-flip. Pink and yellow stay retired.
